2610.13411.title: In-Context Learning for System Identification: Probabilistic Formulation, Long-Sequence Handling, and Benchmark Validation
2610.13411.paper_summary: Traditional system identification typically involves two steps: initially, training data is processed to estimate a model of the system of interest; then, the model is used to predict outputs for new input queries. In contrast, recent in-context learning approaches learn a meta model that maps directly from training data and query inputs to outputs in a zero-shot fashion, bypassing explicit model estimation. This approach leverages a meta model trained offline, on large sets of synthetically generated data, to emulate the behavior of a system identification algorithm. In this work, we advance this meta-learning framework for system identification in three directions. First, we develop a unified probabilistic meta-identification architecture that combines a Transformer-based encoder-decoder with tailored mechanisms for handling long training sequences, enabling calibrated predictions over long horizons. Second, we show how a pre-trained meta model can act as an uncertainty-aware synthetic data generator for classical system identification, providing task-specific data that regularize parametric models when real data are scarce. Third, we systematically evaluate the framework on standard nonlinear system identification benchmarks and on a challenging out-of-distribution scenario, demonstrating competitive accuracy with state-of-the-art methods and strong generalization, including cases where input-only adaptation is sufficient to handle significant distribution shifts.
2610.13411.paper_summary_zh: 傳統的系統識別通常涉及兩個步驟：首先，處理訓練數據以估計感興趣系統的模型；然後，利用該模型對新的輸入查詢進行輸出預測。相較之下，最近的上下文學習方法學習一個元模型，該模型能夠以零-shot的方式直接從訓練數據和查詢輸入映射到輸出，繞過了明確的模型估計。這種方法利用在大量合成生成數據上離線訓練的元模型，以模擬系統識別算法的行為。在這項工作中，我們在三個方向上推進了這一元學習框架以進行系統識別。首先，我們開發了一個統一的概率元識別架構，該架構結合了基於Transformer的編碼器-解碼器和針對長訓練序列的定制機制，使得在長期預測上能夠進行校準預測。其次，我們展示了如何利用預訓練的元模型作為一個具備不確定性感知的合成數據生成器，為傳統系統識別提供特定任務的數據，當真實數據稀缺時，這些數據能夠正則化參數模型。第三，我們在標準非線性系統識別基準和一個具有挑戰性的分佈外場景上系統地評估了該框架，展示了與最先進方法的競爭準確性和強大的泛化能力，包括在僅依賴輸入適應的情況下，能夠處理顯著的分佈轉變。
